records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Glad to have Maple Analytics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Maple Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

draft.subject: Re: Picking back up with Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for being straight with me about still deciding — totally fair, and I won't crowd you while you evaluate. I'll leave the next week to your team.

One thing that often helps during an evaluation: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so putting one real workstream through Wrenfield end to end usually answers the "is this right for us" question faster than a test run.

If it's useful, I'm happy to walk through that one next step with you whenever you're ready — just reply and I'll follow your lead.

Best,
Priya
